$comment: Story 6.36e — A NOMINEE WHO IS ALSO A MEMBER (`2026-10-24-396` Q1 A / Q2 A; `2026-10-24-397` NE3, NE6, AC5). Member-facing, Hindi parity. The English quoted in the story (NE6 / AC5) is FINAL. `{name}` is a person's name: on the declarer's side the name the member SAVED in their contacts (a new mark) or the marked member's REGISTERED name (only once they confirmed — `-309`); on the nominee's side the DECLARER's registered name — each with a `*_no_name` sibling for when there is none. `{trust_name}` is the Trust's name FROM CONFIG (⛔ written here — the legal name is pending), with a `*_no_name` sibling. `t()` THROWS on an unsupplied token. The Hindi is agent-drafted and AWAITS BigDev's approval (the 6.35 LS14 precedent).
